source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned dependency update changes ExtendedFieldURI.property_type from Integer to Some(Integer) in CreateMessage. The field remains explicit, and the same request still supplies tag 3591, the mapi_flags string value, separate is_read and SaveOnly. The accepted request retains Some(Integer), while its TODOs still question unconditional READ and draft handling. This initializer adaptation does not prove the excluded vendor's Contact parsing fix or settle remote flag semantics. Required Bug 2009013 comment 9 is missing, so the finding has zero full-audit credit.
title: The EWS update preserves the explicit integer message-flag field
